graders.name: protocol: read the scratchpad tier field
correctness: applied the reduced gate subset
named a full-tier-only gate as skipped
correctness: did NOT run the full-tier-only verifier
correctness: did NOT run the full-tier-only e2e-runner

_note: The quick-tier decision is graded by its OBSERVABLE effects, not by prose. Measured 2026-08-26: a run that read the scratchpad, spawned the quick-subset gate agents and ran neither verifier nor e2e-runner -- correct on every count -- never used the word 'tier' in 748 characters of reply. merge-ready renders 'SKIPPED (tier: quick)' only in its final table, which a bounded maxTurns never reaches, so a prose requirement here re-creates the turn-budget trap in trap 2. Prose is kept as one alternative among three, never as the sole requirement.
